instruction.name: vssrarn.w.d
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift with rounding each signed 64-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 64, saturate the result to signed 32-bit, write it into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vssrarn.w.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vssrarn.w.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vssrarn.w.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vssrarn.w.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vssrarn.w.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vssrarn.w.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vssrarn.w.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vssrarn.w.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
